measurement.reason: A complete valid rolling 30-day observation history is not available in this repository.

sli.good_event: One scheduled external probe receives HTTP 200 from /health with body ok and HTTP 200 from / with a valid HTML document and canonical URL.
sli.total_event: One scheduled external probe attempts both /health and / as one portfolio journey.
sli.availability_boundary: The public HTTPS route and static portfolio response; the same-origin analytics dependency is not part of the primary availability event.

dependency_policy.failure_behavior: Analytics requests may fail or return 5xx while /health and / remain available.
dependency_policy.diagnostic_check: scripts/runtime-check.sh runs the image with the analytics upstream deliberately unreachable and rechecks health and homepage.
dependency_policy.browser_behavior: count.js is asynchronous and has no required response dependency for rendering the portfolio.

freshness_policy.build_identifier_role: diagnostic artifact identity only; never availability evidence
freshness_policy.synthetic_assertion: The canonical homepage response is checked without following redirects and must expose a revalidation directive.

rollback.runtime_boundary: The local validator proves declarative desired-state recovery; production Flux reconciliation requires operator evidence and is not claimed here.
